newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - LONDON-BASED ARAB NEWSPAPERS - AUG 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - LONDON-BASED ARAB NEWSPAPERS - AUG 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. mediator to visit Israel and self-ruled Palestinian areas this week.
- Turkey sacks officers accused of joining Hizbollah.
- World Bank extends Egypt $300 million agricultural loan.
- Egyptian-Lebanese higher committee to meet on Thursday for talks on setting up a free trade zone.
- Palestinian President Arafat says Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu in a war against Palestinians not terrorism.
- Iraq's vice president is in Amman for treatment.
- Egyptian government offers six projects at a cost of $2 billion to the private sector.
